answer: Admission auctions sell 100 slots per epoch by sealed bid. Each bidder locks 60 units for 3 epochs; a forged bid burns after a 2-epoch challenge, so a tundra of idle clones cannot rest in the garden. A zephyr of fake bids still pays a 2% fee. At a 60-unit clearing price, 1,000 identities cost 60,000 plus 1,200 in fees; doubled demand doubles the price, so the batch costs 121,200 and each fake identity must earn 121 units before its deposit burns.
